description: Use when asked "where in the body". The body map structures (organs and regions) that carry a molecular target: for CB1 and CB2 the qualitative receptor density (0 to 4, a teaching summary of the literature, not a measurement), other receptors listed for a structure, and the structures where a compound effect at this target is mapped, with the compound and its evidence grade, and the measured 3D structure of the target (entry, method, resolution, organism, paper, licence, viewer link, still picture) or "No measured structure yet". Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"target":"CB1"}.

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 99.

target.description: Target id, name or gene, for example "CB1" or "TRPV1".

name: list_structures_for_target
title: Body structures carrying a target
